title: Hearty Peruvian Hazelnut Picarones
description: A traditional Peruvian dish with a twist, featuring shelled hazelnuts and a crispy exterior, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this recipe is made in a tajine clay vessel and utilizes sous vide cooking for added convenience.
instructions: Preheat the sous vide machine to 180 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the mashed sweet potato, chopped hazelnuts, anise seeds, cinnamon, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and flour.
Add the egg mixture to the sweet potato mixture and stir until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place in the tajine clay vessel.
Pour the water into the vessel and cover with a lid.
Place the vessel in the sous vide machine and cook for 2 hours.
Remove the picarones from the vessel and char on a grill or in a skillet for 2 minutes on each side.
